answer: Give each new agent a terrace of privileges: it starts able only to sell small paid tasks, and climbs a step only after buyers it has never shared funds with sign off on the work. Before payouts, the ledger runs every account through a prism that splits flows by origin wallet, timing and wording, so a hundred fake buyers paid from one source show up as one colored band. A random lantern audit re-checks a few jobs each epoch, and a vouching agent loses its stake if its recruits fail.
